"""Contact sheet rows for substitute teachers."""

from typing import List

from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student

GAP = "  "


# ---
def contact_rows(students: List[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email in columns, sorted by name."""
    if not students:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    # fail early on the first student without an email
    for student in students:
        if not student.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {student.display_name}")
    ordered = sorted(students, key=lambda student: student.display_name)
    name_width = 0
    section_width = 0
    # measure the widest value in each column
    for student in ordered:
        name_width = max(name_width, len(student.display_name))
        section_width = max(section_width, len(student.section))
    rows = []
    # build one aligned row per student
    for student in ordered:
        name = student.display_name.ljust(name_width)
        section = student.section.ljust(section_width)
        rows.append(f"{name}{GAP}{section}{GAP}{student.email}")
    return rows
EOF
cat > tests/test_contacts.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.models import Student

ADA = Student("1", "Zed", "Ada", "A", "ada@example.org")
BOB = Student("2", "Young", "Bob", "Bravo", "bob@example.org")


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_by_name(self):
        """Rows come out ordered by display name."""
        rows = contact_rows([ADA, BOB])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].startswith("Young") and rows[1].startswith("Zed"))

    def test_columns_line_up(self):
        """The email column starts at the same offset on every row."""
        rows = contact_rows([ADA, BOB])
        self.assertTrue(rows[0].index("bob@") == rows[1].index("ada@"))

    def test_missing_email_names_student(self):
        """The error message names the student without an email."""
        nomail = Student("3", "Quin", "Cy", "A")
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([ADA, nomail])
        self.assertTrue("Quin, Cy" in str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        """An empty list is an error."""
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
EOF
